description: Create all UI components adapted for React Native and TV navigation: TVFocusable, ContentCard, ContentGrid, VideoPlayer, SearchBar, TabBar, DetailHero, EpisodeList, LoadingState, ErrorState. All styled with StyleSheet using dark theme optimized for TV.
steps: Create /apps/mobile/src/components/TVFocusable.jsx - a wrapper component using TouchableOpacity with TV parallax properties (magnification: 1.05, shiftDistanceX: 10, shiftDistanceY: 10). Implements focus/blur state with 3px #2563EB border on focus. Min 80x80dp touch target. Accepts children, onPress, style, and hasTVPreferredFocus props.

Create /apps/mobile/src/components/ContentCard.jsx - displays movie/TV poster card. Uses Image with lazy loading, shows title, year, rating, genre pills below. Focus border via TVFocusable wrapper. Aspect ratio 2:3 for poster. Shows progress bar overlay when watchProgress prop exists. On press navigates to detail page using expo-router.

Create /apps/mobile/src/components/ContentGrid.jsx - displays items in a FlatList with numColumns (4-6 based on screen width via Dimensions). Handles loading state (shows LoadingState), error state (shows ErrorState), and renders ContentCards. Supports onEndReached for pagination.

Create /apps/mobile/src/components/VideoPlayer.jsx - wraps react-native-webview (WebView) to load the vaplayer.ru embed URL. Handles onMessage events from the player (progress, pause, complete). Saves watch progress via player.js utility every 5 seconds. Shows a back button header. Full screen on TV.

Create /apps/mobile/src/components/SearchBar.jsx - TextInput styled for TV with large font. Includes debounce (300ms). Shows search icon (lucide-react-native). Handles TV remote text input. Dark background with white text.

Create /apps/mobile/src/components/TabBar.jsx - horizontal row of tab buttons (Latest, Trending, Top Rated, Upcoming). Active tab has border-bottom with #2563EB. Each tab is focusable for D-pad navigation. Uses ScrollView horizontal for overflow.

Create /apps/mobile/src/components/DetailHero.jsx - displays poster image (left) + metadata (right) in a row layout. Shows title, year, rating (star icon), genres as pills, overview text, and a Play button. Adapted from web's DetailHero but using RN StyleSheet.

Create /apps/mobile/src/components/EpisodeList.jsx - season selector buttons + episode list (FlatList). Each episode row shows number, title, and play button on focus. Season buttons switch which episodes are displayed.
Create /apps/mobile/src/components/LoadingState.jsx - animated skeleton placeholders using View with opacity animation. Supports 'grid', 'card', and 'detail' types like the web version.
Create /apps/mobile/src/components/ErrorState.jsx - centered error message with AlertCircle icon (lucide-react-native) and 'Try Again' button. Dark theme styling.
acceptance_criteria: TVFocusable implements focus state with blue border and parallax properties
ContentGrid uses FlatList with dynamic numColumns
VideoPlayer uses react-native-webview with onMessage handler
All components use StyleSheet.create for styling (dark theme)
verification: Verify all 10 component files exist in src/components/
Check that imports are correct (react-native, expo-router, lucide-react-native, etc.)
